title: Machine installation
text: Machine uninstall on macOS, systemd Linux and Windows removes saved relay services (launchd jobs, systemd units, scheduled tasks) after their connection aliases are retired. It first closes the identity browsers and Browser QA daemons Yoke started, and stops before any other change when one stays open. If the detached CLI removal fails, its log names a shell command that removes the releases folder without yoke. Unproven ownership or a failed stop retains the machine home and CLI for recovery.
